name: claude_npc_p2_starting_gear (G03/P2; male+female SDCS, reset fixture; NOT RUN)

steps._note: CLASS: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT (RESET fixture: `launch -Reset`; a reused save already contained duplicate SDCS NPCs, so sdcsinspect "ready" expecting exactly one logged synthetic failures). Build with the NPC batch; guard ON. CAPABILITY CHECK (read from source 20261022): `rbnpcadmin inspect <entityId|stableId>` (FormatNpc) prints entityId, stableId, profile, presence, ownership, owner, order, travel, revision, dirty and appearance only - NO equipment slots and NO rbNpcBirthEquipment marker. `rbnpcadmin sdcsinspect <class> [ready]` prints per entity ready/appearance/builds/blocker/physicsLayer/animatorLayers and "count=N" for the class - no gear. `rbnpc inventory` (needs `rbnpc debug on`) prints aggregate counters (RebirthNpcEquipmentService / NativeEquipmentBridge / EquipmentPersistenceStore reports: projections, tracked, resolved, unresolved, stale ...), not slots. The marker lives in saved NPC CVars (rbNpcBirthEquipment 1 complete, -1 gave up; rbNpcBirthTries; rbNpcBirthPending mask bits 0-3 armor, bit 4 weapon; Scripts/NPC/Equipment/RebirthHumanStartingLoadout.cs) and GET /cvar reads only the PLAYER. So the per-slot (4/5 weapon, armor 0-3) readback and the marker value are a MISSING CAPABILITY: a bounded read-only bridge observation `npcgear entity=<id>` (slots, ItemValue names, counts, the three CVars) is proposed; steps that need it are marked PLACEHOLDER and use the expectLog form of the proposed output line `[REBIRTH NPC Gear]` until it exists.

Reset-fixture proof: before spawning, no SDCS survivor of either class may be alive. sdcsinspect (non-ready form) logs count=N for the class; expect count=0. If it is not 0 the save is not a reset fixture and every later count==1 result is void.

Entity ids spawned in THIS run are in the saved spawn replies (out/tests/NNN-action.json); use them for `rbnpcadmin inspect <id>` if wanted. Counting by class with expectLivingEntities already isolates this run once the reset proof above passed.
Birth-equipment retry tick runs about once per second with up to 5 passes and 10 s back-off: wait long enough for the marker to settle before reading.

npcgear (GET /npcgear, read-only) is implemented: expectNpcGear asserts exactly one NPC of the class, rbNpcBirthEquipment==1, rbNpcBirthTries==0, a weapon in toolbelt slot 4 or 5, no item name repeated across equipment + slots 4/5, and saves a per-slot summary to out/npcgear/<save>.json for the reload comparison.

RELOAD COMPARISON PREP: keep this run's out/tests folder (rbnpc inventory, identities, sdcsinspect and future npcgear replies). Quit, relaunch the same save without -Reset, then run claude_npc_p2_starting_gear_after_reload.json.

Diag line `[REBIRTH NPC Equipment Diag]` (Warning level, only on a write/read-back mismatch, RebirthP2NativeWriteDiagnostics.cs): expectNoErrors does NOT cover it (warnings). Absence cannot be asserted by the runner (gap G8): after the run, search Player.log for that text and for `[REBIRTH NPC Loadout] birth equipment GAVE UP` / `starting write failed`; ANY hit fails the case. As a positive control the same expectLog form can assert presence when a mismatch is deliberately provoked (not scripted).
